findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_gear, get_gear · Public sink: share_checklist · Destructive: build_checklist.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_gear, get_gear · Public sink: share_checklist · Destructive: build_checklist

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
